scope: monochrome and color-vision-safe redundant encoding for any future authorized method-only proposal iteration
simulation_limit: The monochrome and Machado severity-100 derivatives are presentation stress tests, not clinical diagnostics.

candidate_evidence.finding: Removing or altering hue does not demote the candidate's dominant headlines, result numbers, matrices, or plot silhouettes and does not create a held gate. The candidate remains a failed scientific presentation in every tested variant.

method_only_evidence.finding: Sealed v8 and the pass-7 caption-safe correction already encode meaning with words, distinct boxes/glyphs/connectors, and stable position. Hue is emphasis only. No new pixel correction is justified.

rules: No method, status, scope, availability, unresolved state, or authorization distinction may be carried by hue alone.
Every branch, condition, column, rail, marker, and status region must have a direct text label and a distinct shape, line style, marker, or stable position.
RESULT HELD and every scene-specific caption-safe gate line must remain readable in color and linear-light grayscale; capsule border and text carry the gate, not amber hue.
Unavailable rails must use both explicit UNAVAILABLE copy and a non-solid or blocked line treatment.
If any result figure is separately authorized later, series must use direct labels plus distinct marker shapes or line patterns; a color legend alone is insufficient.
Human-review the full contact sheet in color, grayscale, protanopia, deuteranopia, and tritanopia simulations before proposal promotion.
Retain the pass-7 bottom-25-percent caption/player-UI safe-area test and the pass-6 360p test; this guard does not replace either.

proposed_integration_guard.reason_no_pixel_change: All seven sealed-v8 scenes and all seven pass-7 caption-safe proof scenes pass the five-variant human review with zero hue-only semantic distinctions. A cosmetic v9 would add custody risk without repairing a demonstrated defect.

integrator_action: Hwao/Fable may adopt this guard alongside the pass-7 caption-safe correction when authoring a separately reviewed proposal iteration. This packet changes no storyboard or pixel and is not v9.
